notes.title: Development Update & News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and Happy New Year 2025!✨ 
This year is special to everyone who eagerly awaiting to join in the warfare.

[b]Warfare ultimatum is planning to have it's public playtest this year,[/b]

[h3]As a glimpse into the progress[/h3]
Look at this light show below:

[previewyoutube=v2CUGWNN5h0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]It's a quick look at the air defense, Along the many building and structures you can build.[/i]

These CIWS (Close-in weapon system) has been utilized to counter aircrafts, they fire 4000 bullets each minuets, roughly 1,300 individual bullets when all four fire together for 5 seconds.


The thing might be interesting, behind the scene firing this many projectiles at the same times would easily crush the performance,
In Warfare Ultimatum this issue has been addressed to be possible to have a very large number of projectiles flying at the same time with minimum effect on the performance.


This is just the beginning, As a small update on the release date, There are exciting features and mechanics that gets a reveal soon.
Don't hesitate to share your thought on them!

Work continues towards the release for this year, Stay tuned, there’s much more to come!
Best wishes in 2025!
